title: lint: action-body capability family follow-ups after #37807 (hook bodies, other capability tokens, updateById advice, ADR-0141 D1 binding list)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of a delivery in review. Out-of-scope findings of the dev on PR #37807 (report 7209661255 on #35143) and contract review 7209862537 (③ boundary flags, N3). None is a line of #35143's Seeds and actions family.

- **Hook bodies.** Hook bodies carry the same `body.capabilities` and the same sandbox refusal, but no rule judges a hook body's `ctx.api` write without `api.write`. Extending `validateActionBodyCapabilities` (#37807) to hook bodies closes it.
- **Other capability tokens.** `ctx.api.transaction` without `api.transaction`, and the other tokens (`email.send` and the rest), are not judged.
- **`updateById` advice.** lint's `action-record-write-discarded` hint recommends `ctx.api.object(OBJ).updateById(...)`, and lint's `API_WRITE_METHODS` grades `updateById`, but the sandbox runner installs no such leaf (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`, `WRITE` = insert/update/delete/updateMany/deleteMany/upsert). Probe an action body calling `updateById` through the sandbox first; then fix the hint (or the runner) so the advice works.
- **ADR-0141 D1 binding list (N3, Tier H).** ADR-0141 D1 and `content/docs/deployment/app-dependencies.mdx` list the bindings the save door judges against the closure (a flow trigger, a dataset base, a list view). After #37807 an action's `objectName` and a flow CRUD/screen node join them. Add a dated note / doc row once #37807 merges (the ADR note may go on the weekly ADR revisions card instead).

Suggested-grade: p3 · consistency; the hook-body item is the user-reachable one (a body that fails at every call).
Dedupe: `hook body api.write`, `updateById sandbox`, `api.transaction capability` found only #35143 and PR #37807.
